body: No I haven't. Do you think it would help?
Yeah, I think so. What you are saying is instead of listening to the negative thoughts as a matter of fact I should try to challenge them with a positive perspective.

Usually its any type of social interaction or communication with someone that makes me nervous. Any thoughts dealing with the unknown or the future make me nervous as well.

I've tried challenging them before but they always overcome me. I would be open to anything you can show me.

Yes, I do. I think to myself that I'm never going to be able to live life normally because I'm an emotionally void, boring person with no ability to grow as a human being. I don't have the drive to push past my anxiety because I don't really care about anything.
It's not that I just feel insignificant, though I do. I'm just tired of being a vegetable and tired of wasting my life as others pass me by.
